summary: Teekay Corp Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing a second quarter 2026 business update under cover of a foreign private issuer report. The filing contains unaudited GAAP financial results, highlights of record tanker rates, and updates on Teekay Tankers' fleet renewal plan—acquisition of two newbuilding contracts for $190M total and two vessel sales for $138M total proceeds—and declaration of a regular $0.25/quarter dividend. There is no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or other special-situation event. This is a routine periodic earnings update and operational review.
